description: This file defines tracing event structures, clock types, and tracer classes for logging and resource usage tracking within the ocudu namespace. It includes functions for managing trace files and various event types for detailed tracing, including resource usage and critical events.

classes.name: null_event_tracer
classes.description: A tracer class that does not write any events, used for null tracing when optimizations are enabled.

classes.name: file_event_tracer
classes.description: Template class for writing trace events to a file, enabled or disabled via template parameter.

classes.name: logger_event_tracer
classes.description: Template class that uses a log channel to write trace events, enabled or disabled via template parameter.

classes.name: test_event_tracer
classes.description: Class for testing that records trace events into a vector of strings.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operators for writing different trace event types to tracers.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Private methods in logger_event_tracer for pushing events into the log channel.

methods.name: pop_last_events
methods.description: Returns and clears the last recorded events in test_event_tracer.

methods.name: set_log_style_format
methods.description: Sets the log style format flag in test_event_tracer.
